verified_facts.text: The hotel opened in 1912.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since its opening in 1912, this San Sebastian hotel has been intricately woven into the cultural and historical fabric of the town's landscape.

verified_facts.text: The hotel was designed by architect Charles Mewes, who was responsible for the Ritz in Madrid and Paris.
verified_facts.excerpt: The majestic design of the hotel by architect Charles Mewes, the man responsible for the Ritz in Madrid and Paris

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a river setting and sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: this San Sebastian luxury hotel offers a stunning river setting and sea views

verified_facts.text: The hotel is named for Spain's regent queen, mother of King Alfonso XIII.
verified_facts.excerpt: Named for Spain's regent queen, mother of King Alfonso XIII

verified_facts.text: The hotel is built in the Belle Epoque style, like the city hall and Victoria Eugenia Theater near La Concha beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: the majority of buildings flanking the famed La Concha beach, including the city hall, Victoria Eugenia Theater and the Hotel Maria Cristina, are constructed in this style

verified_facts.text: The suites are decorated with marble fireplaces, glass lamps and velvet turquoise armchairs.
verified_facts.excerpt: The suites’ contemporary decoration, with marble fireplaces, glass lamps and velvet turquoise arm chairs

verified_facts.text: Guests in the Eduardo Chillida Suite receive tickets to the Chillida Leku museum.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests receive tickets to the Chillida Leku museum for a unique immersion

verified_facts.text: The Bette Davis Suite is dedicated to the actress and is adorned with her photos.
verified_facts.excerpt: Adorned with her iconic photos, the suite features a Belle Époque-inspired living room with modern amenities.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop Royal Terrace Suite has expansive terraces with river views.
verified_facts.excerpt: the rooftop Royal Terrace Suite boasts expansive terraces with majestic river views

verified_facts.text: Some suites have views of the river or old town, and some rooms have terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in a luxury suite in San Sebastian with delightful views of the river or old town, or choose our rooms with terraces for stunning vistas.

verified_facts.text: Family accommodation can host up to four guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: We offer family accommodation in San Sebastian that can host up to four guests.

verified_facts.text: Multi Bedroom Suites with connecting setups are available for larger groups or families.
verified_facts.excerpt: For larger groups or families that require large connecting setups, discover our Multi Bedroom Suites

verified_facts.text: The concierge wears the Les Clefs d'Or insignia of the international concierge society.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our concierge is a bilingual, certified destination expert, proudly wearing the “Les Clefs d’Or,” the gilt insignia of the celebrated international concierge society

verified_facts.text: Dry Martini by Javier de las Muelas serves afternoon tea, classic and signature cocktails, and traditional Basque pintxos.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dry Bar is a sophisticated San Sebastian bar where you can enjoy afternoon tea, classic and signature cocktails, and a wide variety of traditional Basque pintxos

verified_facts.text: Amelia by chef Paulo Airaudo offers contemporary fine dining inspired by the Basque Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Amelia by chef Paulo Airaudo offers a contemporary fine dining experience inspired by the Basque Sea.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits beside the river Urumea, with views of Rafael Moneo's Kursaal building and the Cantabrian Sea beyond.
verified_facts.excerpt: its situation beside the river Urumea, with views of Rafael Moneo’s Kursaal building and the Cantabrian Sea beyond

verified_facts.text: The interior is furnished with a soft color scheme in gray, mauve and turquoise.
verified_facts.excerpt: the interior is voluptuously furnished in the eclectic style of modern luxury, with a soft-edged color scheme in gray, mauve, and turquoise

verified_facts.text: A portrait of Bette Davis presides over the cocktail bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: A portrait of Bette Davis, who smoked her last cigarette here before being rushed to Paris and death, presides over the cocktail bar.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has no pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: has no sprawling gardens, no pool, no big-name spa

verified_facts.text: Rooms do not have a coffee or tea maker.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, rooms at Hotel Maria Cristina, a Luxury Collection Hotel, San Sebastian do not have a coffee/tea maker.

verified_facts.text: The Gallery restaurant has access to a private terrace and serves local Basque dishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: features access to a private terrace, where guests can enjoy a delightful menu showcasing local Basque dishes, seasonal ingredients, and international influences
